profiles.name: Johari Abdul
profiles.description: Johari Abdul serves as Speaker of the Dewan Rakyat, presiding over proceedings and interpreting the Standing Orders. Parliament lists the current tenure as beginning on 19 December 2022.
profiles.affiliation_note: The parliamentary Speaker is recorded without an elected constituency or an assigned party. Independent is the existing app category for this non-partisan office; it does not assert a separate elected independent mandate.

profiles.name: Rushdan Rusmi
profiles.description: Rushdan Rusmi represents Padang Besar, Perlis, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

profiles.name: Zakri Hassan
profiles.description: Zakri Hassan represents Kangar, Perlis, in the Dewan Rakyat. A Bersatu member.
profiles.affiliation_note: Bersatu is not attached to PN in the existing party hierarchy. The 29 October CSA report explicitly says the party remains in opposition; budget cooperation is not treated as joining government.

milestones.title: Consider Youth Parliament participants’ views personally
milestones.description: Johari promised to listen closely to young participants and take their views seriously.
milestones.progress_note: The pledge concerns meaningful consideration, not guaranteed adoption of every proposal. A documented response process or completed set of actions was not verified; outcome and completion remain unknown.

milestones.title: Continue civic education through Sekolah Parlimen
milestones.description: Johari described school visits that let students observe Parliament and understand democratic proceedings.
milestones.progress_note: The ministry’s report of his 12 October address records participation by more than 2,000 schools. This is a dated programme snapshot, with no total-school target or completion denominator.

milestones.title: Establish Al Jazari Centre of Excellence with university partners
milestones.description: Rushdan reported establishing a centre with higher-education partners as part of local development efforts.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved is limited to the reported establishment. An opening date, earlier public promise and wider development outcomes were not verified; the evidence date is the report’s publication date.

milestones.title: Advocate upgrades to Padang Besar’s ICQS facilities
milestones.description: The report identifies border-facility upgrades as a priority Rushdan was raising through Parliament.
milestones.progress_note: This records advocacy documented in January 2025. It does not assign government construction to the MP or claim that the facilities have been upgraded. Delivery, deadline and completion remain unverified.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
